title: AdmissibilityResult
description: Reports whether a source state (or an entire evidence basis) is admissible at a temporal coordinate under a profile, and explains the decision. The result comes FROM the profile; the TIER-Graph core MUST NOT fabricate or infer a competing decision. For conjunctive evidence, the basis is admissible only when every anchor resolves to an admissible source state (see `anchorResults`).

admissible.description: Whether the subject is admissible at the given temporal coordinate under the profile.

profileId.description: The profile that produced this result.

queryTime.description: The query time (`at`) the decision was evaluated for.

observerTime.description: Optional observer time for bitemporal evaluation.

sourceState.description: The source state evaluated, when the subject is a single source state.

reasonCode.description: Stable, machine-readable reason code for the decision.

policyId.description: Optional admission policy in force, when relevant to the decision.

anchorResults.description: Per-anchor admissibility, for evaluating a conjunctive evidence basis. The basis is admissible only if all are admissible.
